reviewFindings.title: Scenario banner falsely claimed a successful local save
reviewFindings.impact: After Start blank (real browser) or a failed localStorage.setItem (controlled adapter), the scenario description said Saved locally on this device while the save status correctly said no saved scenario or could not save. This could cause a user to leave believing data persisted.
reviewFindings.minimumFix: Use a neutral description that directs the owner to the actual save status for both blank and custom scenarios.
reviewFindings.repair: Woz changed the non-fictional scenario description to Your current scenario. Check the save status below. No client information is sent anywhere. Product version became 1.0.1.
rechecks: Real browser Start blank showed neutral banner and correct removed/not-yet-saved status
Real browser final footer and actual JSON download identify v1.0.1
